title: CFB Top Picks Research + Completeness V2 — Step 1 full-page audit + data contract
project: CFB Top Picks Research + Completeness V2
problem: The existing Top Picks page has a polished V5 presentation but no completeness contract covering real logos, multi-source history, market-aware football reasoning, benefits/risks, provenance, or 10/10 ranked-pick coverage.
root_cause: The current detail layer was designed around model probability plus a single Winsipedia historical context fallback. Benefits are derived from history only, team logos are abbreviation placeholders, and no field-level evidence contract exists for offense/defense/pace/recent form or research-source exhaustion.
patch: Freeze a field-level 10-pick completeness contract before product repairs. Require real logos, market-aware reasoning, multi-source history exhaustion, benefits and risks, source/freshness provenance, and DATA_FIELD routing while explicitly protecting API 2.
